verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents non-custodial agent wallets for stablecoin payments over two named rails, x402 and MPP. In the x402 guide, an agent wallet funded with USDC on Base signs the stablecoin payment, and a settlement receipt confirms the payment was processed onchain. A separate quickstart shows an agent authorized as a delegated signer sending USDXM on Base Sepolia. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agent stablecoin settlement works in production (all evidence is vendor docs, and the quickstart runs on testnet).
